title: Eventual vanishing of affine relative higher-image sections
statement: Let I be a nonempty directed partially ordered set, DV,DB:Iᵒᵖ→Scheme diagrams with affine transition morphisms, and η:DV→DB with every η_i quasi-compact and quasi-separated. Let cV,cB be limiting cones and v:cV.pt→cB.pt satisfy πV_i η_i=v πB_i. Let F_i be arbitrary abelian etale sheaves on DV_i with inverse-image coefficient maps φ_ij satisfying the identity and composition coherences. Let A be the coherent diagram of their inverse images on cV.pt, with specified isomorphisms eA_i and the corresponding arrow formula hA. Let cA be a colimit cocone and q a natural number. Let H be a diagram on cB.pt identified by eH_i with πB_i^* H^q(Rη_i,* F_i[0]); its arrows are the specified degree-q commutative-square exchange maps followed by coefficient transitions, conjugated by inverse-image composition and eH_i. Let legs be the natural transformation from H to the constant diagram H^q(Rv_*cA.pt[0]), whose i-th component is eH_i followed by projection-square exchange and the coefficient map eA_i⁻¹ cA.ι_i. For any affine etale test scheme W over cB.pt and section z of H_i(W), if legs_i(z)=0 then H(a)(z)=0 on W for some j and a:i→j. Conventions and constructions: [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves], [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image], [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit], [def-weil-pbc-direct-image], [def-kun-commutative-derived-exchange], [pqf-def-affine-morphism], [def-pc-scheme], [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories], [def-kun-relative-higher-image-exchange].

proof.text: Transport z by E_i and use local surjectivity of [lem-kun-derived-homology-sections-comparison] to lift it to raw derived classes. The limit image of each raw class has zero homology section. Use local injectivity of [lem-kun-derived-homology-sections-comparison] at the target to refine a second time so that its raw derived image is zero. This produces a covering sieve of raw lifts with zero derived images, repeating the existing generic local-zero sieve argument with the cached raw-section functor.

Since W is affine, extract a finite affine etale cover from this sieve. Choose the raw lift on each member and apply [lem-kun-relative-higher-image-finite-raw-vanishing]. It gives one stage arrow killing all the associated transported homology sections. Naturality of E_i and its inverse-hom identity identify these with the restrictions of the original section.

The target H_j is a sheaf, so its separatedness on this finite cover says H(a)(z)=0 on W. The proof explicitly closes the cover under precomposition and uses naturality of H(a) for the restriction equalities. No limit comparison is assumed an isomorphism.

lean.statement:
theorem relativeHigherDirectImage_affine_section_eventually_zero
    {I : Type u} [PartialOrder I] [IsDirected I (· ≤ ·)] [Nonempty I]
    (DV DB : Iᵒᵖ ⥤ Scheme.{u}) (η : DV ⟶ DB)
    [∀ {i j : Iᵒᵖ} (a : i ⟶ j), IsAffineHom (DV.map a)]
    [∀ {i j : Iᵒᵖ} (a : i ⟶ j), IsAffineHom (DB.map a)]
    [∀ i : Iᵒᵖ, QuasiCompact (η.app i)]
    [∀ i : Iᵒᵖ, QuasiSeparated (η.app i)]
    (cV : Cone DV) (hcV : IsLimit cV) (cB : Cone DB) (hcB : IsLimit cB)
    (v : cV.pt ⟶ cB.pt)
    (hu : ∀ i : Iᵒᵖ, cV.π.app i ≫ η.app i = v ≫ cB.π.app i)
    (F : ∀ i : I, Sheaf (DV.obj (op i)).smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
    (φ : ∀ {i j : I} (a : i ⟶ j),
      (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (DV.map a.op)).obj (F i) ⟶ F j)
    (hφid : ∀ i : I, φ (𝟙 i) =
      (eqToIso (congrArg (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) (DV.map_id (op i)))).hom.app
        (F i) ≫ (upperStarId AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (DV.obj (op i))).hom.app (F i))
    (hφcomp : ∀ (i j k : I) (a : i ⟶ j) (b : j ⟶ k),
      φ (a ≫ b) =
        (upperStarComp AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (DV.map b.op) (DV.map a.op)
          (DV.map (a ≫ b).op) (DV.map_comp b.op a.op)).hom.app (F i) ≫
        (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (DV.map b.op)).map (φ a) ≫ φ b)
    (A : I ⥤ Sheaf cV.pt.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
    (eA : ∀ i : I, A.obj i ≅
      (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (cV.π.app (op i))).obj (F i))
    (hA : ∀ (i j : I) (a : i ⟶ j), A.map a =
      (eA i).hom ≫
        (upperStarComp AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (cV.π.app (op j)) (DV.map a.op)
          (cV.π.app (op i)) (cV.w a.op).symm).hom.app (F i) ≫
        (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (cV.π.app (op j))).map (φ a) ≫ (eA j).inv)
    (cA : Cocone A) (hcA : IsColimit cA) (q : ℕ)
    (H : I ⥤ Sheaf cB.pt.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
    (eH : ∀ i : I, H.obj i ≅
      (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (cB.π.app (op i))).obj
        ((DerivedCategory.Plus.homologyFunctor
          (Sheaf (DB.obj (op i)).smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) (q : ℤ)).obj
          ((rightDerivedLowerStarPlus AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (η.app (op i))).obj
            ((DerivedCategory.Plus.singleFunctor
              (Sheaf (DV.obj (op i)).smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) 0).obj
              (F i)))))
    (hH : ∀ (i j : I) (a : i ⟶ j), H.map a =
      (eH i).hom ≫
        (upperStarComp AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (cB.π.app (op j)) (DB.map a.op)
          (cB.π.app (op i)) (cB.w a.op).symm).hom.app
          ((DerivedCategory.Plus.homologyFunctor
            (Sheaf (DB.obj (op i)).smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) (q : ℤ)).obj
            ((rightDerivedLowerStarPlus AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (η.app (op i))).obj
              ((DerivedCategory.Plus.singleFunctor
                (Sheaf (DV.obj (op i)).smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) 0).obj
                (F i)))) ≫
        (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (cB.π.app (op j))).map
          (relativeHigherDirectImageExchange ⟨η.naturality a.op⟩ (F i) (F j) (φ a) q) ≫
        (eH j).inv)
    (legs : H ⟶ (Functor.const I).obj
      ((DerivedCategory.Plus.homologyFunctor
        (Sheaf cB.pt.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) (q : ℤ)).obj
        ((rightDerivedLowerStarPlus AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} v).obj
          ((DerivedCategory.Plus.singleFunctor
            (Sheaf cV.pt.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) 0).obj cA.pt))))
    (hlegs : ∀ i : I, legs.app i = (eH i).hom ≫
      relativeHigherDirectImageExchange ⟨hu (op i)⟩ (F i) cA.pt
        ((eA i).inv ≫ cA.ι.app i) q)
    (W : cB.pt.Etale) [IsAffine W.left]
    (i : I) (z : (H.obj i).obj.obj (op W))
    (hz : (legs.app i).hom.app (op W) z = 0) :
    ∃ (j : I) (a : i ⟶ j), (H.map a).hom.app (op W) z = 0
